ValidationRule.description: Paid invoices are frozen, Void is terminal, and amount changes on Sent invoices need the status to be reset to Draft in the same edit.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), OR( AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), 'Paid'), OR(ISCHANGED(Amount__c), ISCHANGED(Discount__c), ISCHANGED(Tax_Rate__c))), AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), 'Void'), ISCHANGED(Status__c)), AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), 'Sent'), ISCHANGED(Amount__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Draft'))) ) )
